verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com with agent-directed guidance. A second probe shows Radar docs are available as clean Markdown (radar.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs for Radar. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, and confirmation that the Stripe-wide llms.txt specifically indexes the Radar pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
